reuse.why: Extends the existing isWeekendOrHoliday predicate with a small isHoliday helper reusing monthUtils.dayFromDate, so every holiday path (date shift, skipped-day check, daily scan) picks it up.

duplication.why: No logic duplicated; the MM-DD match is one slice inside the single holiday predicate.

placement.why: Lives in shared/schedules.ts next to the existing holiday predicate that all callers use.

scope.why: Only the predicate, tests and a release note.

maintainability.why: Tiny, documented helper at the one point the holiday rule is decided.
